title: feat(components,i18n): a create form says when the server will fill a field (objectui#12108)
body:
Fixes #12108
Clause-②: yes
Refs: #11914

## What changes

A create form now says when the server will fill a field. A field whose `defaultValue` is a CEL Expression envelope (`{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'today()' }`) or a runtime token (`NOW()`, `current_user`) opens empty: the client cannot evaluate it, and the submit leaves the key out so the server resolves it at insert. The form renderer now draws **Set automatically when saved.** in that field's description slot while the field is empty. One locale key, `form.serverDefaultHint`, in all ten packs.

## Where it lands, and why not where the claim expected

The claim's file surface named `plugin-form` or `fields`. Measured, the code that draws the field row is `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` (`renderFormField`), so the hint lands there, per the dispatch's producer-side clause. `schemaDefaults.ts` gets docblock lines only.

- **Not a placeholder.** The registered field widgets read their placeholder off the field metadata (`fieldData?.placeholder` in `TextField`, `config?.placeholder` in `SelectField`), not off the host's `placeholder` prop, and `DateField`, `DateTimeField`, `TimeField`, `BooleanField` and `UserField` draw none. A placeholder could not reach the date field a `today()` default sits on.
- **One draw site for every layout.** `ObjectForm`, `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`, `TabbedForm`, `SplitForm` and `WizardForm` all render through the `form` renderer, which already computes `isServerOwnedValue(field, isCreateForm)` per field for the create-mode `required` suppression, and holds the live value.
- **One classifier.** `serverOwned` is computed once in `renderFormField` and read by both the `required` suppression and the hint. Emptiness is `isMissingForRequired`, the predicate `omitServerResolvedDefaults` drops a key by, so the hint shows exactly while the submit will leave the key out. A typed value removes it.
- **Announced.** The hint sits inside the one `FormDescription`, after any authored `description`; `FormControl` already names that element's id in the control's `aria-describedby`.
- **Never wrong, sometimes absent.** It is not drawn on a control that takes no input. The containers pass `previousValues` in edit mode only, so the renderer reads a `mode: 'view'` form as create; every field there is disabled, and this gate keeps the hint off it. The cost: a locked field on a real create form gets no hint, which is a missing hint, not a wrong one.

## Coverage, measured

`serverDefaultHint-12108.test.tsx` drives `ObjectForm` through all seven routes (flat, sections, `modal`, `drawer`, `tabbed`, `split`, `wizard`) with the real registered widgets:

| Field | Widget that draws the empty control | Hint |
|---|---|---|
| text, CEL default | `TextField` | yes |
| date, CEL default, required | `DateField` | yes |
| select, CEL default, required | `SelectField`; the trigger still reads "Select an option" | yes, under the trigger |
| number, CEL default | `NumberField` | yes |
| datetime, `NOW()` token | `DateTimeField` | yes |
| text, CEL default plus an authored `description` | `TextField` | yes, after the description, in the same element |
| select, literal default (CONTROL) | `SelectField`, seeded "Open" as today | no |
| text, no default | `TextField` | no |

Also pinned: the hint goes when a value is typed and comes back when it is cleared; it is in the control's `aria-describedby`; edit and view forms (flat and modal) show none.

Not covered: a **boolean** (see Acceptance notes), and the console's second form renderer, `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` (`/forms/:name`, `/f/:slug`).

## The required-field measurement

A required field with a CEL default does **not** block Save. Pinned for `date` and `select` in six routes (flat, sections, modal, drawer, tabbed, split): no required marker, `create` is called, both keys are absent from the payload. `createDefaults.test.tsx` already pinned the same rule on `text` fields. The wizard's submit is its last-step button and is not driven here; its hint is pinned.

- Client predicate: `isRequiredInForm` in the builders and `resolveFieldRuleState`'s `serverOwnedValue` in the renderer, both on `isRuntimeDefault`. This PR does not change either.
- Server half (objectstack `origin/main` `a18c5149`): the insert path runs `applyFieldDefaults` before `validateRecordInScope` (the `[#4633]` note in `validateData` states it), and `applyFieldDefaults` evaluates a `{ dialect, source }` envelope for a field that arrives absent or null. The server fills the field; it does not refuse it.
- Bound: if the server's CEL evaluation fails, `applyFieldDefaults` logs a warning and leaves the field unset, and a required field is then refused by the server. Nothing on the client can see that case.

## Clause-② surface

- Exports added: none. Props added: none (`renderFieldDescription` is module-private).
- Locale key added: `form.serverDefaultHint`, in ten packs. `TranslationKeys` widens, so `@object-ui/i18n` is `minor`.
- DOM: the hint span carries `data-server-default-hint="true"`, a locator in the manner of `data-required-marker`.

## Acceptance notes

- **A boolean with a CEL default: the default never applies from these forms.** The renderer starts an unsupplied two-state control at `false` (the cloud#972 seed in `form.tsx`'s `defaultValues`), so the submit sends `false` and the server stores it instead of evaluating the declaration. Measured in this pin's first run: the payload held `{ status: 'open', active: false, … }`. No hint is drawn there, which is the true answer. Not changed here: exempting server-owned booleans from that seed is a UX decision (what a switch shows while undecided), not a mechanical one. Reported to the seat.
- **`FormPage`**, the console's second form renderer, already leaves server-owned blanks out and lowers `required` on them, but draws no hint. It is outside this card's file surface; reported.
- The README's six cross-file line addresses are re-cited by symbol or quoted text, as AGENTS.md rule 11 asks of a touched file.
- The hint says *that* the server sets the value, never *what*: no client-side CEL evaluation, no new server door.
